text_block_list.name: Uzuki
text_block_list.orig_text:
た、
倒せたんでしょうか？

text_block_list.name: Mio
text_block_list.text:
Wait—waaagh! It's still hopping mad!
Man, what a toughie!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ってわー！　
まだまだ元気みたい！
しぶといなーもー！

text_block_list.name: Rin
text_block_list.text:
It ran further into the town.
We should chase after it before it attacks anyone.
text_block_list.orig_text:
街の奥に逃げたみたいだね。
誰かが襲われる前に
追いかけて倒さないと。
